title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132711)
description: CVE-2026-132711 is a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Wikimedia Foundation's mediawiki/services/parsoid component. It involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the AttributeExpander.php file. The vulnerability affects versions from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The CVSS score is 5.3, indicating a medium severity. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
